segment.description: Standing Rock Creek, Stewart County (West Tennessee): a small creek draining west to Kentucky Lake / the Tennessee River near the Fort Henry area. TWRA stocks it at the 'Standing Rock Creek Spring Trout Site' (36.4368, -87.9985), essentially the USGS 03606125 station location. Note: despite an 'upper-cumberland' region label in the catalog, both the USGS station and the stocking site place this creek in the Tennessee River/Kentucky Lake drainage (HUC 06040005), not the Cumberland/Obey system.
segment.boundaries: Stewart County reach from upper creek to the Kentucky Lake mouth (~36.42, -88.05); keyed to USGS 03606125 'Standing Rock Creek near Forthenry' (36.4370, -87.9992).

coldSource.notes: Station identity verified via https://waterservices.usgs.gov/nwis/site/?sites=03606020,03606125,03605968&siteOutput=expanded&format=rdb (STANDING ROCK CREEK NEAR FORTHENRY, Stewart County, HUC 06040005).

holdover.detail: No holdover documentation found. Stocking is Seasonal only: weeks of 2/22, 3/22, 3/29/2026, all Rainbow Trout.

wildPopulation.detail: No wild trout population documented. The creek has no entry anywhere on TWRA's trout-regulations page (no wild-trout, special-regulation, or delayed-harvest listing; verified by string search of the live page) and no trout survey record was found.

overallSurvivalRead.oneLineWhy: USGS summer grab samples 1984-1988 at the stocking-site station (03606125) ran 21-26 C with 25-26 C in June-July, and the only documented fishery is a 3-week Feb-Mar seasonal rainbow stocking.
